environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; large, clear wings with thick veins; wide-set red eyes; heavy, robust body.

visual_logic.composition: A side-profile of a cicada clinging to the 'shingle-like' bark of an Araucaria tree. A drip of golden resin is visible nearby. The background shows the distant floodplain under a setting sun.
visual_logic.ground: The view is elevated, looking down at the purple-red forest floor far below.
visual_logic.lighting: Golden, late-afternoon light that illuminates the veins in the cicada's wings like stained glass.
